title: Raw Material Selection
description: We carefully select high-quality coconut shells from local sources, ensuring they are dry, clean, and free from contaminants.

title: Carbonization
description: Coconut shells are burned in controlled kilns at high temperatures with limited oxygen to produce high-quality charcoal.

title: Crushing & Sieving
description: The carbonized charcoal is crushed into fine powder and sieved to ensure uniform particle size for consistent briquette quality.

title: Mixing with Natural Binder
description: Charcoal powder is mixed with natural tapioca starch binder to create a moldable mixture that holds its shape after drying.

title: Briquetting / Molding
description: The mixture is pressed into desired shapes and sizes using mechanical briquetting machines with precise molds.

title: Drying & Curing
description: Fresh briquettes are sun-dried and then oven-cured to reduce moisture content and ensure structural integrity.

title: Quality Control & Lab Testing
description: Each batch undergoes rigorous testing for ash content, moisture, fixed carbon, burning time, and calorific value.

title: Packaging
description: Approved briquettes are packed according to customer specifications - bulk, full packaging, or woven bags.

title: Storage & Export
description: Packaged products are stored in dry warehouses and prepared for export shipping to destinations worldwide.
